verdicts.reason: Both break the core design. The S-A-L-E letters are pulled out of their white lantern circles and scattered across the strip, so 'SALE' no longer reads as a word, and the empty circles sit stacked as a meaningless column. The lanterns, clouds and ingots are shrunk into illegible clumps. In A, the 'L' and 'E' are crammed together at different sizes against the right side. B spaces the stray letters a little more evenly, but its 'S' nearly touches the decoration clump, so it is only marginally less bad.
